title: Item
subtitle: 本課限定語境：item = one individual thing, object, product, entry, or unit in a group, list, coll
description: 本課限定語境：item = one individual thing, object, product, entry, or unit in a group, list, collection, shop, or system · 「物品；項目；單件；條目」

words.note: 較正式地表示某一件具體物品。
words.example: Each article was inspected before shipment.
words.exampleZh: 每件物品在出貨前都經過檢查。

exercises.original: Each item was inspected before shipment.
exercises.zh: 每件物品在出貨前都經過檢查。
exercises.upgrade: Each article was inspected before shipment.

options.explanation: 也可，但較一般，沒有正式商業語感。
正式表示「每一件物品」很自然。
如果這些物品是商品也可，但題句未明示生產／銷售。

exercises.original: The customs officer examined every item in the bag.
exercises.zh: 海關人員檢查了袋中的每件物品。
exercises.upgrade: The customs officer examined every article in the bag.

options.explanation: 在較正式檢查語境中可自然表示一件物品。
袋中物件未必都是商品。
可以是所有物，但不如 article 中性。

exercises.original: Every item of clothing must have a label.
exercises.zh: 每件衣物都必須有標籤。
exercises.upgrade: Every article of clothing must have a label.

options.explanation: article of clothing 是標準固定搭配。
不自然說 object of clothing。
可在庫存系統使用，但日常服裝類別不如 article 自然。

words.note: 表示一個可被看見、觸摸或辨識的實體物件。
words.example: A small metal object was found under the table.
words.exampleZh: 桌下發現了一個小金屬物件。

exercises.original: A small item was lying on the floor.
exercises.zh: 地上有一個小物件。
exercises.upgrade: A small object was lying on the floor.

options.explanation: 可見、可觸摸的實體物件最自然。

exercises.original: The scanner can detect any metal item.
exercises.zh: 掃描器可以偵測任何金屬物件。
exercises.upgrade: The scanner can detect any metal object.

options.explanation: 實體金屬物件是最精確。

exercises.original: Do not place heavy items on the shelf.
exercises.zh: 不要把重物放在架上。
exercises.upgrade: Do not place heavy objects on the shelf.

words.note: 最廣泛、最口語的近義詞。
words.example: Please put your things in the locker.
words.exampleZh: 請把你的東西放進儲物櫃。

exercises.original: Please put your items in the locker.
exercises.zh: 請把你的東西放進儲物櫃。
exercises.upgrade: Please put your things in the locker.

options.explanation: 日常口語中最自然、最廣。
不是所有物品都是商品。

exercises.original: I need to buy a few items for the kitchen.
exercises.zh: 我需要買幾樣廚房用品／東西。
exercises.upgrade: I need to buy a few things for the kitchen.

options.explanation: 口語中表示幾樣未特指的物品最自然。
通常是已擁有的個人物品。

exercises.original: There are several items on the desk that do not belong there.
exercises.zh: 桌上有幾樣不該放在那裡的東西。
exercises.upgrade: There are several things on the desk that do not belong there.

options.explanation: 未必是某人的隨身物品。

words.note: 表示被生產、出售或提供給顧客的東西。
words.example: Each product has a unique barcode.
words.exampleZh: 每件產品都有獨立條碼。

exercises.original: Each item in the shop has a barcode.
exercises.zh: 店內每件產品都有條碼。
exercises.upgrade: Each product in the shop has a barcode.

options.explanation: 零售店＋barcode 是典型商品語境。
可能有庫存 entry，但題句是商品本身。

exercises.original: Customers can return any damaged item within 30 days.
exercises.zh: 顧客可在30天內退回任何損壞產品。
exercises.upgrade: Customers can return any damaged product within 30 days.

options.explanation: customer returns 是標準零售語境。

exercises.original: The website displays the price of every item.
exercises.zh: 網站顯示每件產品的價格。
exercises.upgrade: The website displays the price of every product.

options.explanation: 價格＋網站商品頁面最自然。
article 可表示商品，但較正式且不如 product 常見。
可以是商品清單 entry，但題句說的是被定價的東西。

words.note: 表示從某類物品中抽出的一件。
words.example: Each piece of equipment must be checked.

exercises.original: Each item of equipment must be checked before use.
exercises.zh: 每件設備使用前都必須檢查。
exercises.upgrade: Each piece of equipment must be checked before use.

options.explanation: equipment 是不可數名詞，a piece of equipment 是標準結構。
若設備以庫存單位計算可用，但一般句子不如 piece 自然。
設備不一定是銷售商品。

exercises.original: The room contains several items of furniture.
exercises.zh: 房間內有數件家具。
exercises.upgrade: The room contains several pieces of furniture.

options.explanation: furniture 不可數，因此用 pieces of furniture。
語義可行，但不自然配 of furniture。
如果是商品目錄可用，但不是房間陳設語境。

exercises.original: The report contains one important item of information.
exercises.zh: 報告包含一項重要資訊。
exercises.upgrade: The report contains one important piece of information.

options.explanation: 可技術化計量資訊，但一般不自然。
a piece of information 是標準搭配。
如果是資料庫條目才更合適。

words.note: 表示一個獨立的計量、庫存或生產單位。
words.example: The warehouse shipped 500 units this morning.
words.exampleZh: 倉庫今早運出了500件產品單位。

exercises.original: The factory produced 2,000 items yesterday.
exercises.zh: 工廠昨天生產了2,000件產品單位。
exercises.upgrade: The factory produced 2,000 units yesterday.

options.explanation: 生產數量計算中最自然。

exercises.original: Only five items remain in stock.
exercises.zh: 庫存只剩五件。
exercises.upgrade: Only five units remain in stock.

options.explanation: inventory 語境中是標準計數單位。
可能是庫存記錄，不是實際貨品數量。
也可在正式商業語境，但 units 更自然於 stock count。

exercises.original: The company sold 300 items of the new model in one week.
exercises.zh: 公司一星期內售出300件新型號產品。
exercises.upgrade: The company sold 300 units of the new model in one week.

options.explanation: 也可說 300 products，但 units of the model 更精確計量。
sales quantity + model 是典型搭配。

words.note: 表示清單、表格、資料庫、比賽或日誌中的一項。
words.example: Please check each entry in the database.
words.exampleZh: 請檢查資料庫中的每一項記錄。

exercises.original: Please check each item in the database.
exercises.zh: 請檢查資料庫中的每一項記錄。
exercises.upgrade: Please check each entry in the database.

options.explanation: database 中的一項記錄最自然叫 entry。
資料庫技術上可有 object，但一般此句不是這個意思。

exercises.original: One item on the list is missing a date.
exercises.zh: 清單中有一個條目缺少日期。
exercises.upgrade: One entry on the list is missing a date.

options.explanation: 如果是商品清單才可能。
list 中的一項文字／記錄最自然。

exercises.original: The form contains ten items that applicants must complete.
exercises.zh: 表格中有十個申請人必須填寫的項目。
exercises.upgrade: The form contains ten entries that applicants must complete.

options.explanation: 表格中的填寫項目可自然稱 entries。

words.note: 較正式地表示一件可出售的商品。
words.example: Every article of merchandise must display a price.
words.exampleZh: 每件商品都必須標示價格。

exercises.original: Every item for sale must display a price.
exercises.zh: 每件出售商品都必須標示價格。
exercises.upgrade: Every article of merchandise must display a price.

options.explanation: 正式零售／商業語境中非常精確。
表示商品推銷／陳列活動。

exercises.original: The store records each item of merchandise separately.
exercises.zh: 商店分別記錄每件商品。
exercises.upgrade: The store records each article of merchandise separately.

options.explanation: 庫存計量可用，但不如 target 正式描述商品本身。
那是商品記錄，不是商品本身。

exercises.original: Damaged items of merchandise were removed from the shelves.
exercises.zh: 損壞商品被從貨架上移走。
exercises.upgrade: Damaged articles of merchandise were removed from the shelves.

words.example: Passengers should keep their possessions with them.
words.exampleZh: 乘客應把個人物品隨身攜帶。

exercises.original: Passengers should keep all personal items with them.
exercises.zh: 乘客應把所有個人物品隨身攜帶。
exercises.upgrade: Passengers should keep all personal possessions with them.

options.explanation: 強調這些物品屬於乘客本人。
可以是物件，但沒有所有權焦點。
是文法上的所有格形式。

exercises.original: She packed her most valuable items before moving.
exercises.zh: 搬家前，她收拾好自己最貴重的物品。
exercises.upgrade: She packed her most valuable possessions before moving.

options.explanation: 搬家＋自己的貴重物品，是典型用法。
她擁有的東西不一定是商品語境。

exercises.original: The hotel is not responsible for items left in the room.
exercises.zh: 酒店不對遺留在房間內的個人物品負責。
exercises.upgrade: The hotel is not responsible for possessions left in the room.

options.explanation: 酒店責任聲明中常指住客個人物品。

falseSynonyms.zh: 貨物 ≠ 單一 item goods 通常是複數集合概念，表示貨物／商品總體。
設備 ≠ 單件 item equipment 通常是不可數名詞。 應說：
falseSynonyms.point: an item of equipment a piece of equipment

falseSynonyms.zh: 東西 ≠ 正式 item stuff 很口語，而且通常不可數。
材料 ≠ 一件物品 material 表示製造東西的材料，不一定是成品 item。
資產 ≠ 一般 item asset 強調經濟／會計／價值屬性。
個人物品 ≠ 所有 item belongings 通常表示某人攜帶或擁有的物品，而且多用複數。
單複數陷阱 - item = 一項／一件 - items = 多項／多件 things 只是 thing 的複數，不應被當作另一個獨立近義詞學習。
多義詞陷阱 article 可以表示： - 文章 - 條款 - 一件物品 必須靠語境判斷。
